original_test_intent: Perform one approved HIB CPLD upgrade or downgrade through WebUI, reach the vendor-safe commit state, execute the mandated controlled AC cycle and prove HIB interconnect, CPLD, BMC and host recovery.
original_method: Bind HIB slot/board revision/CPLD and signed image, preserve baseline, submit once through the vendor UI, monitor commit, then have an authorized operator/PDU perform the exact off/on interval before interconnect and platform verification.
manual_activity: The owner approves image and both destructive phases; an operator verifies the HIB UI target, supervises commit and performs the documented AC cycle while automation captures task, PDU, console, interconnect and health evidence.
required_inputs: SUT/BMC/HIB slot, board revision, CPLD and interconnect topology
AC safe point and off/on intervals
safety_requirements: Treat HIB programming and AC interruption as critical/destructive
Do not use blind unplug or arbitrary remote power commands
Drain workloads and confirm data safety
Keep power stable until safe point
Monitor HIB, interconnect, PDU, console, BMC, POST and devices
agent_execution_scope: After separate approval record exact AC sequence
engineer_actions: Approve HIB target, image, flash and AC cycle

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Inapplicable: inlet thermal workload belongs to row 782 and cannot program HIB CPLD, prove commit or recover the interconnect after AC cycle.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use the vendor WebUI HIB-CPLD workflow plus validated AC/PDU procedure after exact topology, image, commit and recovery gates pass.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Upgrade/downgrade, WebUI, mandatory AC cycle, Script and 15/15-minute values are retained.

modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds HIB slot/topology identity, commit signal, controlled power and interconnect recovery.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction; successful flash requires post-cycle HIB/interconnect and platform health.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Wrong HIB/image or premature cycling may disable board interconnect and require external programming.

project_override_considerations: The project may choose direction and PDU/operator method, but must bind exact HIB/CPLD/image, commit signal, AC timing, interconnect oracle and recovery.
expected_evidence: Approval, HIB/CPLD/topology identity, current/target versions and image digest
Separate AC approval and PDU/operator timing
